sloka: सुकुमार्या तपस्विन्या सुमन्त्र सह सीतया ।राज पुत्रौ कथम् पादैः अवरुह्य रथात् गतौ ॥२-५८-९॥
transliteration: sukumāryā tapasvinyā sumantra saha sītayā ।rāja putrau katham pādaiḥ avaruhya rathāt gatau ॥2-58-9॥

translations.english: O Sumantra how did those two princes along with pitiable, delicate Sita, alight from the chariot, and enter the forest on foot?
